entities.summary: Andrey Sergeyevich Nikitin is a Russian economist and government official who served as the Governor of Novgorod Oblast from 2017 to 2025. He is currently serving as Minister of Transport since 8 July 2025. He previously served as Deputy Minister of Transport between February and July 2025.
